target: Penjual buah di pasar itu sangat ramah kepada saya.
english: The fruit seller at that market is very friendly to me.
grammar: pe- turns a verb into the doer: jual (sell) → penjual (seller).

target: Pembeli sering bertanya tentang ukuran sepatu di toko kami.
english: Buyers often ask about shoe sizes at our store.
grammar: pe- + beli = pembeli, the one who buys — the same pattern gives penjual and pekerja.

target: Ayah saya bekerja sebagai penulis buku anak.
english: My father works as a children's book writer.
grammar: pe- copies the meN- sound change: tulis → menulis, so the writer is penulis.

target: Para pekerja pabrik mulai bekerja jam tujuh pagi.
english: The factory workers start working at seven in the morning.

target: Penyanyi terkenal itu menyanyikan lagu daerah tadi malam.
english: That famous singer sang a regional song last night.
grammar: menyanyi has no object; when a song is named, use menyanyikan: menyanyikan lagu daerah.

target: Adik saya ingin menjadi pemain sepak bola terkenal.
english: My younger sibling wants to become a famous soccer player.

target: Penari muda itu berlatih setiap sore di gedung seni.
english: That young dancer practices every afternoon at the arts building.

target: Pelari tercepat dalam lomba itu berasal dari kota kami.
english: The fastest runner in that race comes from our city.

target: Perenang itu berlatih di kolam renang setiap hari Sabtu.
english: That swimmer trains at the swimming pool every Saturday.
grammar: r-roots take pe- without n: renang → perenang (swimmer), like berenang.

target: Pengajar bahasa Inggris kami berasal dari Australia.
english: Our English teacher comes from Australia.

target: Para pelajar rajin membaca buku pelajaran di ruang kelas.
english: The students diligently read their textbooks in the classroom.
grammar: One root, two people: pengajar teaches, pelajar learns — both from ajar.

target: Para penonton bola berteriak gembira sepanjang pertandingan tadi malam.
english: The soccer spectators shouted happily throughout the match last night.

target: Pendengar radio bisa mengirim pertanyaan lewat telepon.
english: Radio listeners can send questions by phone.

target: Pengunjung museum harus menyimpan tas besar di loker.
english: Museum visitors must store large bags in the lockers.

target: Para penumpang harus menunjukkan tiket kepada petugas stasiun.
english: The passengers must show their tickets to the station officer.
grammar: tumpang (ride along) → penumpang: the passenger, the one who rides.

target: Pengemudi taksi itu tahu jalan pintas ke bandara.
english: That taxi driver knows a shortcut to the airport.

target: Pemilik toko itu membuka pintu jam delapan pagi.
english: That shop owner opens the door at eight in the morning.

target: Pencuri itu ditangkap polisi di dekat stasiun kereta.
english: That thief was caught by the police near the train station.

target: Pelukis itu menjual lukisan pemandangan pantai di pasar seni.
english: That painter sells beach scenery paintings at the art market.
grammar: One root, two nouns: pelukis is the painter, lukisan is the painting.

target: Pemandu wisata selalu menjelaskan sejarah candi kepada tamu baru.
english: The tour guide always explains the temple's history to new guests.

target: Pelatih renang memberi latihan baru kepada perenang muda.
english: The swimming coach gives new drills to the young swimmers.

target: Pelayan restoran baru saja membawa minuman dingin ke meja kami.
english: The restaurant waiter just brought cold drinks to our table.

target: Para perawat di rumah sakit itu sangat sabar.
english: The nurses at that hospital are very patient.

target: Petani itu menanam sayuran di belakang rumahnya.
english: That farmer plants vegetables behind his house.
grammar: A few jobs take plain pe- with no sound change: petani (farmer), petugas (officer).

target: Pedagang kecil menjual makanan ringan di depan sekolah.
english: Small vendors sell snacks in front of the school.

target: Penjaga malam memeriksa pintu kantor setiap dua jam.
english: The night guard checks the office doors every two hours.

target: Pengirim surat itu lupa menulis alamat lengkap.
english: The sender of the letter forgot to write the complete address.

target: Penerima hadiah utama akan diumumkan malam ini.
english: The recipient of the main prize will be announced tonight.

target: Penyewa mobil harus mengembalikan kunci sebelum jam lima sore.
english: Car renters must return the key before five in the afternoon.

target: Pembantu rumah tangga itu memasak makanan untuk keluarga kami.
english: That household helper cooks food for our family.

target: Makanan di warung kecil itu murah dan sangat enak.
english: The food at that small food stall is cheap and very delicious.
grammar: -an names the result: makan (eat) → makanan (food, the thing eaten).

target: Ibu sedang menyiapkan minuman hangat untuk para tamu.
english: Mother is preparing warm drinks for the guests.

target: Pakaian kotor itu harus dicuci hari ini.
english: Those dirty clothes must be washed today.
grammar: -an from pakai (wear) gives pakaian — clothing, the things worn.

target: Bangunan tua di pusat kota itu sekarang menjadi museum.
english: That old building in the city center is now a museum.
grammar: bangun (build) → bangunan: the built thing, a building.

target: Saya membawa bacaan ringan untuk perjalanan kereta besok.
english: I am bringing light reading for tomorrow's train trip.

target: Tulisan tangan dokter itu susah sekali dibaca.
english: That doctor's handwriting is very hard to read.

target: Masakan ibu selalu membuat saya rindu rumah.
english: Mother's cooking always makes me miss home.
grammar: masakan is the dish, the result of cooking; the act itself is masak/memasak.

target: Anak kecil itu menyimpan mainan di bawah tempat tidur.
english: That little child keeps toys under the bed.

target: Ada banyak pilihan menu di restoran baru itu.
english: There are many menu choices at that new restaurant.

target: Kiriman dari nenek tiba di rumah tadi pagi.
english: The package from grandma arrived at the house this morning.
grammar: kirim (send) → kiriman: the thing sent, like a parcel from family.

target: Kami menerima undangan pernikahan dari teman kantor kemarin.
english: We received a wedding invitation from an office friend yesterday.

target: Jawaban kamu benar, tapi tulisannya kurang jelas.
english: Your answer is correct, but the writing is not clear enough.

target: Saya selalu menulis catatan penting di buku kecil ini.
english: I always write important notes in this small notebook.

target: Lukisan di dinding kamar itu dibuat oleh kakek saya.
english: The painting on that bedroom wall was made by my grandfather.

target: Sayuran segar dijual murah di pasar pagi.
english: Fresh vegetables are sold cheaply at the morning market.
grammar: sayur is a vegetable dish; sayuran with -an covers vegetables in general.

target: Cucian menumpuk karena mesin cuci rusak minggu ini.
english: The laundry is piling up because the washing machine broke this week.
grammar: cuci (wash) → cucian: the washing, the pile of clothes to wash.

target: Jangan lupa mengangkat jemuran sebelum hujan turun.
english: Don't forget to bring in the drying laundry before the rain falls.

target: Tabungan saya belum cukup untuk membeli motor baru.
english: My savings are not yet enough to buy a new motorbike.
grammar: tabung (save up) → tabungan (savings): the money set aside.

target: Latihan pagi ini lebih berat daripada latihan kemarin.
english: This morning's practice is heavier than yesterday's practice.

target: Tontonan malam ini cocok untuk seluruh keluarga.
english: Tonight's show is suitable for the whole family.
grammar: tonton (watch) → tontonan: the show, the thing watched.

target: Hiburan di pesta besok adalah tarian tradisional dari Bali.
english: The entertainment at tomorrow's party is a traditional dance from Bali.

target: Pesanan kami baru datang setelah tiga puluh menit.
english: Our order only came after thirty minutes.

target: Panggilan dari kantor masuk saat saya sedang makan siang.
english: A call from the office came in while I was having lunch.

target: Kenalan lama saya sekarang tinggal di Surabaya.
english: An old acquaintance of mine now lives in Surabaya.
grammar: kenal (know someone) → kenalan: an acquaintance, someone you know.

target: Pemandangan dari kamar hotel ini indah sekali.
english: The view from this hotel room is very beautiful.
grammar: pandang (gaze) → pemandangan: the view, everything your eyes take in.

target: Pengumuman keberangkatan terdengar jelas di ruang tunggu.
english: The departure announcement could be heard clearly in the waiting room.

target: Potongan harga di toko itu berlaku sampai hari Minggu.
english: The discount at that store is valid until Sunday.
grammar: potong (cut) → potongan: a cut — potongan harga is a price cut.

target: Minuman dingin ini dibuat dari buah segar dan es.
english: This cold drink is made from fresh fruit and ice.

target: Oleh-oleh khas kota ini adalah makanan manis dari kelapa.
english: This city's typical souvenir is sweet food made from coconut.

target: Ibu punya simpanan beras di dapur untuk bulan depan.
english: Mother has a stock of rice in the kitchen for next month.

target: Harapan saya tahun ini adalah hidup lebih sehat.
english: My hope this year is to live more healthily.

target: Terima kasih banyak atas bantuan kamu minggu lalu.
english: Thank you very much for your help last week.
grammar: bantu (help, verb) → bantuan (help, noun): the aid that is given.

target: Ukuran sepatu ini terlalu besar untuk kaki saya.
english: This shoe size is too big for my feet.

target: Aturan baru di kantor mulai berlaku bulan depan.
english: The new rules at the office take effect next month.

target: Pekerjaan baru saya dimulai hari Senin depan.
english: My new job starts next Monday.
grammar: pe-…-an wraps a whole activity into a noun: kerja → pekerjaan (work, a job).

target: Perjalanan ke desa nenek memakan waktu lima jam.
english: The trip to grandma's village takes five hours.
grammar: jalan → perjalanan: the whole journey, not just the road.

target: Pertanyaan siswa itu dijawab dengan sabar oleh guru.
english: That student's question was answered patiently by the teacher.

target: Pertemuan tim pemasaran dipindah ke hari Rabu.
english: The marketing team meeting was moved to Wednesday.

target: Pernikahan kakak saya dirayakan di gedung besar.
english: My older sibling's wedding was celebrated in a big hall.

target: Perbaikan jalan membuat perjalanan kami lebih lambat.
english: The road repairs made our trip slower.
grammar: baik (good) → perbaikan: the act of making good — a repair.

target: Pembayaran kamar hotel bisa dengan kartu atau uang tunai.
english: Payment for the hotel room can be by card or cash.

target: Perbedaan harga di dua toko itu cukup besar.
english: The price difference between those two stores is quite big.

target: Pengalaman kerja di restoran membantu saya mendapat pekerjaan baru.
english: Work experience at a restaurant helped me get a new job.

target: Perusahaan tempat ayah bekerja sudah pindah ke gedung baru.
english: The company where father works has moved to a new building.
grammar: usaha (effort, business) → perusahaan: a company, where business happens.

target: Permainan tradisional itu masih dimainkan anak-anak di desa.
english: That traditional game is still played by children in the village.

target: Perayaan tahun baru di kota ini selalu ramai.
english: The New Year celebration in this city is always lively.

target: Pendaftaran kelas memasak dibuka sampai akhir bulan ini.
english: Registration for the cooking class is open until the end of this month.
grammar: daftar (a list; register) → pendaftaran: the registration process.

target: Penginapan murah dekat pantai selalu penuh saat liburan.
english: Cheap lodgings near the beach are always full during the holidays.
grammar: inap (stay over) → penginapan: a place to stay the night.

target: Pelajaran hari ini tentang nama hari dan bulan.
english: Today's lesson is about the names of days and months.

target: Pengumuman penting akan dibacakan sebelum rapat dimulai.
english: An important announcement will be read out before the meeting starts.

target: Pemeriksaan tiket dilakukan sebelum penumpang naik kereta.
english: Ticket checks are done before passengers board the train.

target: Pertandingan sepak bola sore ini ditunda karena hujan deras.
english: This afternoon's soccer match was postponed because of heavy rain.

target: Persiapan pesta ulang tahun dimulai dari pagi sekali.
english: Preparations for the birthday party started very early in the morning.

target: Pemesanan meja untuk makan malam bisa lewat telepon.
english: Table reservations for dinner can be made by phone.

target: Pengiriman barang ke luar kota butuh waktu tiga hari.
english: Shipping goods out of town takes three days.

target: Kelas bahasa selalu dimulai dengan perkenalan singkat.
english: The language class always begins with a short introduction.

target: Pertolongan pertama diberikan oleh perawat di tempat kejadian.
english: First aid was given by a nurse at the scene.

target: Pembukaan toko baru itu ramai sekali kemarin sore.
english: The opening of that new store was very crowded yesterday afternoon.

target: Penutupan jalan utama membuat kami lewat jalan lain.
english: The closure of the main road made us take another road.

target: Pencarian kunci yang hilang memakan waktu satu jam.
english: The search for the lost key took one hour.

target: Penjualan tiket konser dimulai jam sepuluh pagi besok.
english: Concert ticket sales start at ten tomorrow morning.

target: Pembelian tiket kereta bisa lewat aplikasi di ponsel.
english: Train ticket purchases can be made through a phone app.

target: Pemilihan ketua kelas diadakan hari Jumat depan.
english: The class leader election will be held next Friday.

target: Kesehatan keluarga lebih penting daripada uang banyak.
english: Family health is more important than a lot of money.
grammar: ke-…-an makes a state noun: sehat (healthy) → kesehatan (health).

target: Kebersihan dapur harus dijaga setiap hari.
english: The cleanliness of the kitchen must be maintained every day.
grammar: bersih (clean) → kebersihan (cleanliness): the state of being clean.

target: Keamanan hotel ini baik karena ada penjaga di pintu.
english: This hotel's security is good because there is a guard at the door.

target: Kesalahan kecil dalam laporan itu sudah diperbaiki.
english: The small mistake in that report has been corrected.
grammar: salah (wrong) → kesalahan: a mistake, the wrong thing done.

target: Keputusan penting itu dibuat setelah pertemuan panjang.
english: That important decision was made after a long meeting.

target: Kemacetan di jalan utama membuat saya terlambat ke kantor.
english: The traffic jam on the main road made me late to the office.
grammar: macet (stuck) → kemacetan: a traffic jam, the state of being stuck.

target: Kecelakaan kecil di dapur membuat jari ibu terluka.
english: A small accident in the kitchen left mother's finger injured.

target: Kebiasaan minum teh sore datang dari keluarga nenek saya.
english: The habit of drinking afternoon tea comes from my grandmother's family.
grammar: biasa (usual) → kebiasaan: a habit, what is usually done.

target: Keinginan adik saya tahun ini adalah sepeda baru.
english: My younger sibling's wish this year is a new bicycle.

target: Kedatangan tamu dari Jepang disambut oleh pemilik hotel.
english: The arrival of the guests from Japan was welcomed by the hotel owner.

target: Keberangkatan pesawat kami ditunda dua jam karena cuaca buruk.
english: Our plane's departure was delayed two hours because of bad weather.
grammar: berangkat (depart) → keberangkatan (departure); datang → kedatangan (arrival).

target: Kami kehujanan di tengah jalan menuju pasar.
english: We got caught in the rain on the way to the market.
grammar: ke-…-an can mean 'hit by': hujan (rain) → kehujanan (caught in the rain).

target: Dia kepanasan karena berdiri lama di bawah matahari.
english: He got overheated because he stood for a long time under the sun.

target: Anak itu kedinginan setelah berenang terlalu lama di kolam.
english: That child got cold after swimming too long in the pool.

target: Kehilangan dompet membuat perjalanan kami sedikit kacau.
english: Losing the wallet made our trip a little chaotic.
grammar: hilang (lost) → kehilangan: the loss, or the experience of losing.

target: Kebahagiaan keluarga terlihat dari foto liburan mereka.
english: The family's happiness shows in their vacation photos.

target: Kelelahan setelah kerja lembur membuat dia tidur lebih cepat.
english: Tiredness after working overtime made him go to sleep earlier.

target: Kesempatan kerja di kota besar biasanya lebih banyak.
english: Job opportunities in big cities are usually more plentiful.
grammar: sempat (have the chance) → kesempatan: an opportunity.

target: Kejadian lucu itu terjadi saat pertemuan keluarga besar.
english: That funny incident happened during the big family gathering.

target: Kemenangan tim kami dirayakan dengan makan malam bersama.
english: Our team's victory was celebrated with a dinner together.

target: Kelebihan kamar ini adalah pemandangan gunung dari jendela.
english: The advantage of this room is the mountain view from the window.
grammar: lebih (more) → kelebihan: a plus point; kekurangan is the weak point.

target: Kekurangan uang membuat kami menunda liburan tahun ini.
english: A lack of money made us postpone our vacation this year.

target: Kesulitan terbesar saya adalah bangun pagi setiap hari.
english: My biggest difficulty is waking up early every day.

target: Keramaian pasar malam membuat anak-anak sangat senang.
english: The bustle of the night market made the children very happy.

target: Penjual minuman di depan bangunan itu sudah pulang.
english: The drink seller in front of that building has already gone home.

target: Pekerjaan pelayan hotel dimulai dengan pemeriksaan kamar kosong.
english: The hotel attendant's work begins with a check of the empty rooms.

target: Banyak pengunjung pameran membeli lukisan kecil sebagai oleh-oleh.
english: Many exhibition visitors buy small paintings as souvenirs.
grammar: pamer (show off) → pameran: an exhibition, things put on show.

target: Kesehatan para pekerja dijaga dengan pemeriksaan rutin di kantor.
english: The workers' health is maintained with routine checkups at the office.

target: Perjalanan panjang itu ditutup dengan makanan enak di penginapan.
english: That long trip was rounded off with delicious food at the lodging.

target: Pertanyaan para penonton dijawab langsung oleh penulis buku itu.
english: The audience's questions were answered directly by the book's author.

target: Kebersihan dan keamanan menjadi alasan kami memilih penginapan itu.
english: Cleanliness and safety are the reasons we chose that lodging.
grammar: alas (base) → alasan: a reason, what an opinion stands on.

target: Latihan ringan setiap pagi menjaga kesehatan badan ayah saya.
english: Light exercise every morning maintains my father's health.
